kDefinition: layer scroll speed / page scroll speed; 1=follows content, 0=pinned to viewport, >1=rushes past

styleDelta.palette-shift: 鼠尾草绿 #8FA07E → 深叶绿 #6E8268,暖花瓣粉 #E7C8B0 首次明显渗入(预告抵达)
styleDelta.light-direction: 15:30 午后偏低的柔光,自右上斜入,较 s3 更暖,仍无硬阴影

genPolicy.noPortraitGen: 本屏不出任何 9:16/竖版 —— 极端竖比模型会自行加戏(s3 已验证)。所有共用层出横向或方形,两端由 pad_canvas 各补一份。
genPolicy.sharedWhy: L1/L2 是水平同质的带状层;L3 花拱是左右对称、居中的物体 —— 缩到各端 canvasW 贴底即可,不需要竖版变体(沿用 s1 敞开门的判定)。

styleBibleInline: Soft botanical watercolor illustration, loose wet-on-wet washes with delicate fine ink linework and dry-brush soft edges; NOT a photograph, NOT thick gouache impasto, NOT a 3D render. Palette: cream #F4EFE4, pale sage #C7D4B8, sage green #8FA07E, deep leaf green #6E8268, warm petal blush #E7C8B0, honey warm light #EBD9B4 — low saturation, cream and green dominant. Light: soft diffuse mid-afternoon light, no hard shadows, gentle warm diffusion from upper-right. Atmosphere: airy, highly transparent, faintest haze. Texture: cold-press watercolor paper grain with light tooth, no digital noise, no HDR, no glow, no glassmorphism. Camera: standing eye-level view, horizon around 40% from the bottom of the frame, mid focal length, gentle aerial perspective, no wide-angle distortion.

L3-flower-arch.note: 第二个 zoom-through 的洞。中央开口必须与背景同为纯白,抠图后成为透明洞。取景同 s1:桌面缩到约 95% 视口高、居中落地,让整座拱一眼看全;手机贴底填宽(约 138%)。

verified.note: 叠预览已核对(layers/final/s4-desktop-preview.png / s4-mobile-preview.png),以下为实测参数,装站时照抄。

mobile.copyAt: 上半段留白,顶起 0.14H —— 拱在下半屏,文案不与画面重叠(沿用 s1 手机判定)

postProcess.L3-flower-arch: 左右各 12% 做 alpha 斜坡(已烘进 layers/final/s4-*/L3-flower-arch.png)。源图两侧把矮墙与花坛画到了出血边,直接抠会在桌面留下可见直角边。

framing.mobileSkyGradientFix: L0-sky 的 CSS 渐变改为 #EAEEDB → #E7EBD6 → #F3F2E2 → #D9DCBC → #B9CCA4(自 desktop 出图天空取样)。原写的 #8FA07E → #6E8268 → #E7C8B0 比桌面暗太多,两端会明显不是同一屏;底部那段暖粉会从拱洞里透出来变成一块粉色。
framing.copyPlacement: 文案「花拱下相见」压在拱洞内的留白;日期地点做成拱下方的一张小标注卡,不塞进句子

gradient.note: 自 desktop 出图天空取样,两端同调;原来的深绿→暖粉方案已废,见 framing.mobileSkyGradientFix

art.content: 午后天空:上鼠尾草绿向下渐入深叶绿,底缘渗一点暖粉。desktop 出图;mobile 走 CSS 线性渐变。

desktop.prompt: Soft botanical watercolor illustration, loose wet-on-wet washes, cold-press watercolor paper grain, no digital noise, no HDR, no glow; NOT a photograph, NOT 3D. Match the art style, colour palette, brush texture and lighting of the reference image exactly. A soft full-frame afternoon sky wash: pale sage #C7D4B8 at the top graduating gently downward into sage green #8FA07E, with a faint breath of warm petal blush #E7C8B0 near the very bottom edge. art.content: 拱门之外的远景树影,横带状,提亮偏冷(空气透视)。水平同质,两端共用。

shared.prompt: Soft botanical watercolor illustration, loose wet-on-wet washes, delicate fine ink linework, dry-brush soft edges, cold-press watercolor paper grain, no glow; NOT a photograph, NOT 3D. Match the art style, colour palette, brush texture and lighting of the reference image exactly. Subject: a soft distant treeline and low hedging forming a low horizontal band, painted in pale sage #C7D4B8 and sage green #8FA07E, lightened and slightly cooler for far-distance atmospheric perspective. Render as solid clustered silhouette masses — no fine twigs, no hair-thin tips at the edges. Composition: a low horizontal band across the lower portion of the frame, anchored to the bottom edge, isolated element only; the rest of the frame empty. Background: solid pure white #FFFFFF, completely flat, no gradient, no vignette, no texture, no horizon line. Do not include: any arch or gate, the path, foreground plants, sky, cast shadows, any other depth layer, haze bleeding to edges, depth-of-field blur, motion blur, watermark, text. Edges: crisp, high-contrast silhouette, clean separation from background. Aspect ratio: 3:4

Match the art style, colour palette, brush texture and lighting of the reference image exactly. art.content: 挂满花的木拱 = 全站第二个 zoom-through 的洞。左右对称居中,中央开口宽阔通透且为纯白(抠图后成透明洞)。藤花集中在拱顶与两侧立柱,不侵入开口。

shared.prompt: Soft botanical watercolor illustration, loose wet-on-wet washes, delicate fine ink linework, dry-brush soft edges, cold-press watercolor paper grain, no digital noise, no glow, no glassmorphism; NOT a photograph, NOT 3D. Match the art style, colour palette, brush texture and lighting of the reference image exactly. Subject: a freestanding wooden garden arch seen head-on and perfectly symmetrical — two weathered pale wooden posts carrying a gently curved arched top, thickly garlanded with climbing roses and small blossoms in warm petal blush #E7C8B0 and cream, with deep leaf green #6E8268 foliage. The flowers and foliage cluster on the arched crown and spill a little way down the outer sides of both posts. There are NO gates or doors — it is an open archway. Render all vines, leaves and blossoms as solid clustered silhouette masses — no fine wispy tendrils or stray thin stems. Composition: the whole arch including its crown fills the frame, anchored to the bottom edge, isolated element only, centred and symmetrical; the opening beneath the arch is wide, tall and completely unobstructed. Background: solid pure white #FFFFFF, completely flat, no gradient, no vignette, no texture, no horizon line — and the opening under the arch must be that SAME solid pure white, completely empty (it is a see-through hole; put nothing inside it). Do not include: any garden, path, sky, seating or scenery visible through the opening, gates or doors, cast shadows on the ground, reflections, side flower beds, any other depth layer, haze, depth-of-field blur, motion blur, watermark, text. Edges: crisp, high-contrast silhouette, clean separation from background. Aspect ratio: 1:1
